machine.about_section: I'm a Platform Architect (%s), working with some brilliant folks at Vercel (%s), solving the most challenging problems in the industry for our wonderful customers (%s). My team is hiring - check out our open roles: %s

resume_section.intro: Authorized to work in the US without restriction. Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish. References available upon request.

jobs.title: VERCEL, PLATFORM ARCHITECT [IC4]
jobs.description: • Drive architecture and performance strategy for Vercel's most strategic accounts, leading production-ready deployments of modern web and AI workloads and codifying best practices into reusable blueprints that scale customer adoption.

jobs.title: AMAZON WEB SERVICES, SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT - SOFTWARE, INTERNET, AND GENERATIVE AI MODEL PROVIDERS [L5]
jobs.description:
• Led architecture reviews for ISV and internet-native customers (up to $500M ARR), improving reliability, security, and cost efficiency per AWS Well-Architected Framework, identifying $50K/month in savings after assessment of varied workloads.
• Advised CTO/CISO/VP Engineering stakeholders on cloud strategy, rightsizing, and modernization, influencing $12M+ in annual AWS spend and guided production-ready designs for large-scale, customer-facing workloads.
• Partnered with product, support, and specialist teams to resolve critical issues (including an Amazon SES Mail Manager defect) and unblock complex RDS workloads, strengthening platform adoption and trust for a key strategic account.

jobs.title: AMAZON WEB SERVICES, CLOUD APPLICATION ARCHITECT (SOFTWARE ARCHITECT) [L5]
jobs.description:
• Led the technical delivery of Allstate Insurance's contact center modernization, deploying a custom Amazon Connect solution with a React frontend and Node.js serverless microservices to migrate 500+ agents to production, resulting in $62,000 in immediate licensing cost reductions (projected $1.3M+ over 5 years).
• Spearheaded the architecture and development of a new Auction Notification infrastructure for Amazon Logistics, directing the technical implementation for a team of 7 SDEs using Java and internal build systems (Brazil, Pipelines) to enhance a critical component of Amazon's global logistics network.

jobs.title: AMAZON WEB SERVICES, CLOUD APPLICATION DEVELOPER (BACKEND SOFTWARE ENGINEER) [L4]
jobs.description: • Created an event-driven, Python-based, containerized batch processing solution via Terraform IaC that significantly improved efficiency for Johnson & Johnson's cross-account data transfer challenges, achieving over a 97.5% process efficiency gain.

jobs.title: GARTNER INC., FULL-STACK SOFTWARE ENGINEER
jobs.description: • Pioneered the company's adoption of the Next.js front-end (React-based) framework after independently building 2 large-scale Proof of Concepts and hosting 3 technical workshops; my team was the first in our company to adopt this technology, allowing us to define the future of front-end engineering at Gartner.

jobs.title: EXXONMOBIL CORPORATION, FULL-STACK SOFTWARE ENGINEER
jobs.description:
• Built and deployed RESTful API leveraging the .NET 5 framework from the ground up, as an individual effort. The API processed 4+ million responses daily across 12 endpoints, enabling 6 teams to secure access to the 80+ TB of field asset data.
• Retired an on-prem database solution and migrated to a cloud-hosted solution, leading to cost savings of $10,000+/month.
• Leveraged Redis Cache and optimized SQL queries to reduce API response times from 10 seconds to ~.25 seconds.

leadership.title: LATINOS@AMAZON – HOUSTON CHAPTER, FOUNDING VICE PRESIDENT
leadership.description: • Spearheaded the establishment of the Latinos@Amazon Houston, securing executive sponsorship, organizational funding, and leading the official chartering process from concept to launch.

leadership.title: OPEN-SOURCE PROJECT – DESKTOP AUTOMATION SOFTWARE, LEAD DEVELOPER AND ARCHITECT
leadership.description: • Leading a globally distributed team of 19 developers to maintain and add new functionality to our Cloud-Enabled .NET WPF Desktop Client with 20,000+ active users (and over 325,000 total downloads) on a steady 3-month release cycle.
